---
name: 💡 Feature Request
about: Suggest a new agent, integration, or capability
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature address? (e.g., "The Researcher only uses one search engine. Adding a DuckDuckGo fallback would improve reliability when Tavily rate-limits.")

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
How would you implement this? Which agent or component would it affect?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Any alternative approaches you've thought about.

## 📎 Additional Context
Links to related issues, papers, or libraries that could help implement this.
